==Description==
'''E-165''' will be one of the many entity you will encounter in [[Section E]], more info shown below.

==Mechanics==
'''E-165''' once spawned will place itself in the middle of the room, staying stationary, it will damage anyone who flashes a light onto it<br>he spawns on a timer when in dark rooms, and may not spawn in [[Red Rooms]].

==Strategies==

* Just don't shine a light on it
*

==Trivia==

* There are sometimes that '''E-165''' will despawn immediately after you flash a light in it.
